scientific_integrity: The proof is an explicit induction and exact reconstruction of local-factor counts. Exhaustive finite checks are corroboration only. No experimental computation is treated as proof for all k.
scientific_limitations: The exact twelve-class formula is proved only at dyadic lengths \(2^k\) with \(k\ge4\); the all-even-length lemma identifies classes but does not count them at arbitrary lengths. No statement is made about full 2-regularity, odd lengths, or independence of review. Earlier literature displays finite plots and unproved conjectural 3-block coding complexity; equivalent results elsewhere remain possible.
title: Twelve dyadic three-Abelian classes in the period-doubling word
